description: The page URL on the site redirects to a page on ANOTHER origin, which is then processed.

thin.note: Page redirects must stay on the allowed host: a redirect to another host fails the job. NOTE: in these fixtures {{site}} and {{cdn}} share the hostname 127.0.0.1 and differ only by port, so the production predicate isAllowedUrl(url, ALLOWED_HOSTNAME), a hostname comparison, would FOLLOW this redirect; the test injects a host:port predicate (isPageHostAllowed) for this case. redirect-page-off-host-alias-hostname is the same rule with a different hostname.
